merchant/30321.htm.text: Trader Sydnia: What are you looking for? We sell only the best weapons, and we stand behind everything we sell here. Would you like to have a look around? I'm sure you'll find something you like. And I promise you that you won't find lower prices anywhere else!

links.text: Ask about the local lord and tax rate.

merchant/30321-1.htm.text: Trader Sydnia: Well, what exactly are you looking for?

merchant/30321-pk.htm.text: Trader Sydnia: Oh ... you're a wanted criminal. My man may report you to the village guards if he sees you. Escape to another place at once. I cannot sell to you now, but I trust you will be a future customer. When you are free once more, please pay our shop a visit. Don't forget us.

@questlist.text: Quest list window (the server lists the quests this NPC has for you; shown only when there is more than one).
